facts.F1: Bug 6686 — Jira OAuth: write-back cannot write with read-only scopes. The Jira OAuth connection asks only for read scopes (read:jira-work, read:jira-user, board/sprint/issue/project read scopes, offline_access) in JiraOAuthProvider.cs. Write-back (Data Sync Mappings) on a Jira OAuth connection therefore cannot write: Jira refuses the update for lack of write:jira-work. Jira API-token connections are not affected. To check: confirm the failure on a Jira OAuth connection with a write-back mapping; then decide whether Jira OAuth should ask for write:jira-work only when write-back is set up, the same way as the Azure DevOps change in Story 6672. Found while preparing Story 6672. Maintainer decisions 2026-11-24: mirror the Azure DevOps change (ask write:jira-work only when write-back mappings are saved, record what Atlassian granted, show the Rights line and the Sign in again warning for Jira too); a Jira OAuth sign-in stored before rights were recorded counts as read-only; the write-consent warning names the connection's tracker (Jira or Azure DevOps).
